name: System Monitor
author: BaseCamp Linux
description: Live CPU, RAM, GPU/CPU temperature and disk usage on DisplayPad buttons
help: Assign 'Monitor: CPU', 'Monitor: RAM', 'Monitor: CPU Temp', 'Monitor: GPU Temp' or 'Monitor: Disk' to DisplayPad buttons; the tiles update every 2 seconds. 'Monitor: CPU+GPU Temp' shows both on one key, switching every N seconds (action value e.g. 'F,5' = Fahrenheit, 5s). 'Monitor: Disks (cycle)' rotates through every mounted filesystem (action value = seconds per disk).
